drafts.subject: Delivery job

drafts.rationale: EV-K-A1 states each delivery job may make no more than three delivery attempts in total, and that the first attempt is included in that limit.
EV-K-B1 states the worker waits five seconds after the preceding failed attempt before starting any retry attempt.
EV-K-N1 requires that a job still unsuccessful after its last permitted attempt remain in failed state for operator review and not be automatically discarded.

value.text: Leave the job in failed state and require operator review; do not automatically discard the job.
